description: Vortexova  is passionate about space exploration, science, and technology. Through ExoPulse, we explore fire behavior in microgravity using NASA research and data analysis. We welcome curious, creative, and motivated participants interested in Python, AI/ML, aerospace, physics, data analysis, web development, UI/UX, graphic design, or scientific research. We value teamwork, fresh ideas, commitment, and a willingness to learn. Let's innovate together!
